brief:
Israeli occupation forces conducted raids on the towns of Balata and Faraoun in the Tulkarm district, according to Shehab Wire. The military incursion targeted the two neighboring communities in the northern West Bank area, which has experienced repeated Israeli operations in recent months.

The scope and duration of the raids remained unclear. No immediate reports detailed casualties, arrests, or the stated objective of the operation. The towns have been frequent flashpoints for Israeli military activity and Palestinian resistance in the Tulkarm governorate.
